environment: Isolated Chrome for Testing; synthetic browser pages and real extension/IndexedDB.

checks.name: Real v2→v3 upgrade preserves legacy text and supplies active status
Actual backup preview and atomic import preserve text; repeated import is idempotent
Actual IndexedDB transaction abort retains the whole original database
Clear history removes the internal pre-import snapshot
Native catalog covers three windows and 100 tabs with exact duplicates
Real save/close/restore keeps duplicate multiplicity and repeated restores reuse successful pages
Native navigation invalidates a close preview before saving or closing
Task completion atomically releases two actual window bindings and rejects stale revisions
Recently closed is unavailable until its optional permission is granted
Real sidebar performs cross-window search with no overflow or duplicate IDs
Native full workspace exposes the file import and conflict preview surface
